macros.name: babelname
macros.doc: \babelname stores the corresponding name of the currently active language (variant) in babel.

macros.name: languagevariant
macros.doc: \languagevariant stores the language variant if set.

macros.name: latinAlph
macros.doc: \latinAlph{⟨counter⟩}: Representation of counter as a upper-case letter: 1 = A, 2 = B, etc.

macros.name: mainlanguagename
macros.doc: \mainlanguagename stores the (polyglossia) language name of the main document language.

macros.name: mainlanguagevariant
macros.doc: \mainlanguagevariant stores the language variant of the main document language if set.

macros.name: resetdefaultlanguage
macros.doc: \resetdefaultlanguage[⟨options⟩]{⟨lang⟩} (experimental): Switches the default language to another one in the middle of a document: this may have adverse effects!

macros.name: selectbackgroundlanguage
macros.doc: \selectbackgroundlanguage{⟨lang⟩}: this selects the global font setup and the numbering definitions for the default language.

envs.name: hyphenrules
envs.doc: The ⟨hyphenrules⟩ environment only switches the hyphenation patterns to the one associated with the language ⟨lang⟩ (or the language variety as specified via ⟨options⟩).
